Log the reading in the Natural Cycles app, which analyzes your cycle pattern.

faq.answer: Yes, the app is designed to work with irregular cycles, though it may take longer to learn your pattern.

faq.answer: The subscription includes the app and a high-precision basal thermometer.

content.intro: Indoor air can be up to five times more polluted than outdoor air, but Air Doctor purifiers make it easy to breathe cleaner air at home. Designed with a medical-grade, multi-stage filtration system, Air Doctor captures 99.99% of airborne particles, including dust, pollen, mold spores, pet dander, and even volatile organic compounds (VOCs). benefits.title: UltraHEPA™ Filtration
benefits.description: Captures 99.99% of airborne particles as small as 0.003 microns – far beyond standard HEPA filters.

Clean air is released through the top vents, circulating throughout the room.
